Story = I was in an auto and a child 10 years old forcing his grandfather to sit in auto (behaviour: like he is mature + understanding) I thought boy running away from his mother due to his mistake but no the story was something else, grandfather want to know so he asked him in breaking words and random playful manner so he can explain in comfortable way. 
(Explain in short) = The boy parents had divorce and the boy custody go to his dad, the boy mother was his dad 2nd Wife, the boy was talking (childes way) "my new mother is creating situation which let me Uncomfortable and don't want to stay there." + New mom means 4th wife of his dad (Shocked).
(1st Wife) = Left because she want rich husband + She ran away with someone else.
(2nd Wife) = She had kid (which was the boy) + left due to his husband bad habits + drinking problem.
(3rd Wife) = She don't want to raise his 2nd Wife child + She was a Psycho + She killed his family member and got prison for Lifetime  + Child Abuse too.
(4th Wife) = Is gold digger, married only for money, want expensive things like forcefully demanding Apple products, BMW car & luxurious life + she is cheating his husband by calling his 2-3 boyfriends in his Apartment, sleeping with them in Husband house and even his child existence in home taking hours not to coming out of his room with friends + taking drugs with his boyfriend inside his room + Smoking too much (Completely Failed as A Mother).

(Boy) = He is tired of seeing his new Mothers Life and his Actions + Parenting Issue + Not getting Love and Care. 
I was hearing everything + Auto Driver too. My heart break and things, what was the boy fault why is childhood is getting ruined even I can feel his is each words have dark depth which made me Silent.
